body: A platform for building, deploying, and running automated workflows with AI agents.
plain_description: **Put a team of AI experts to work on content, sales, research, and recurring tasks.** Brief specialists in plain English and review their work. Otto coordinates the team and keeps you updated.
technical_description: AutoGPT provides a hosted platform and a self-hosted option for coordinating AI experts and building workflows. Users can choose or create specialists, connect apps, set instructions and spending controls, and review activity. Its visual builder connects blocks and controls workflow steps; workflows can also be run or built from code or an AI coding agent. Self-hosting uses Docker and requires model credentials and infrastructure management.
title: AutoGPT
